changes.text: 秦军解去，邯郸得救，赵国保住。赵孝成王与平原君亲到边界迎接，平原君背着箭袋在前引路，赵王再拜说「自古賢人未有及公子者也」，平原君不敢自比于人。

The Qin army broke off and withdrew. Handan was relieved, Zhao preserved. King Xiaocheng of Zhao and Lord Pingyuan came out to the border to receive him in person, Lord Pingyuan carrying the quiver and arrow-case and leading the way. The king of Zhao bowed twice and said, in translation, that of worthies since ancient times none had been the prince's equal. At that moment Lord Pingyuan dared not compare himself with anyone.

dispositions.rationale: story.6 首次出现赵王时改为“赵孝成王”（英文 King Xiaocheng of Zhao），后文仍简称“赵王”。这样读者不会把他误认作 hook.0 括注里的赵惠文王。依据是原文 E24 紧接迎接之后，称存赵后感念公子的赵王为“赵孝成王”，可知救赵时在位的就是孝成王。其余文字未改。

evidence.quote: 趙王及平原君自迎公子於界
趙孝成王德公子之矯奪晉鄙兵而存趙
